title: President of India: appointments, vacancy, Articles, current

boxes.title: Election & office: added points
items: APPSC-G2 **2023** key: elected MPs, elected MLAs of States, **Delhi/Puducherry**
Acts done before the election is voided ==remain valid==
**Art. 59**: not a member of any legislature; **rent-free** residence
Oath: "preserve, protect and defend the Constitution"; resignation in writing, VP informs **Speaker**
Word "impeachment" only for President; judges, VP are "**removed**"; President may appear or be represented

boxes.title: Appointment basis
head: Appointment
Basis
rows: Arts. **148, 155, 76**; on Council of Ministers' advice (Art. 74)
Regulations under **Art. 240**: Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep, DNH&DD

boxes.title: Vacancy & discretion
items: Causes: expiry, death, resignation, removal, **disqualification**, election void
Expiry: election **before** term ends; outgoing President ==continues until successor enters office==
Acting VP **stops** chairing Rajya Sabha (Deputy Chairman presides)
Discretion: PM in **hung Parliament**; dismiss govt that lost majority; **pocket veto**
Declares **war**, concludes **peace** on advice; treaties in his name

boxes.title: Pardon & veto: added detail
items: Art. 72 covers: **court-martial**, offence against **Union law**, **death sentence**; ==**amnesty** outside Art. 72==
Judicial review only for **mala fide**, arbitrary, irrelevant grounds
**Madras HC** Full Bench (**Apr 2026**): Governor bound by Cabinet advice on remission
Absolute veto also when Cabinet resigns before assent; **Money Bill**: assent or withhold only

boxes.title: Current & comparative
items: VP **Jagdeep Dhankhar** resigned (**July 2025**) → ==**C.P. Radhakrishnan**==; third mid-term VP vacancy
Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Ordinance, **2026** (gazette **16 May 2026**): judges **33 → 37**
US **22nd Amendment**: two terms; South Korea: single 5-year term
Sanjiva Reddy: elected **1977** (⚠ other notes: 1978); Epuru Sudhakar case arose from **AP**
